OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: Interval between two runs of the connector.

GREEDYBEAR_API_KEY.description: GreedyBear API token (used for advanced and ASN feeds). Leave empty to use only the public standard feed (no auth required).

GREEDYBEAR_TLP_LEVEL.description: Default TLP level for all imported entities.

GREEDYBEAR_OPERATOR_NAME.description: Name of the organization operating the honeypots. This becomes the 'created by' identity in OpenCTI.

GREEDYBEAR_OPERATOR_DESCRIPTION.description: Optional description of the honeypot operator.

GREEDYBEAR_OPERATOR_URL.description: Optional URL of the honeypot operator (website, GitHub, etc.).

GREEDYBEAR_FEED_TYPE.description: Honeypot feed type. Comma-separated names or 'all'. Valid values: all, cowrie, dionaea, adbhoney, ciscoasa, conpot, ...

GREEDYBEAR_INCLUDE_MASS_SCANNERS.description: Include IoCs flagged as mass scanners.

GREEDYBEAR_INCLUDE_TOR_EXIT_NODES.description: Include IoCs flagged as Tor exit nodes.

GREEDYBEAR_MAX_AGE.description: Maximum age of entries in days (advanced feed, default 3).

GREEDYBEAR_FEED_SIZE.description: Maximum number of IoCs to import per run (default 5000).

GREEDYBEAR_MIN_SCORE.description: Minimum recurrence_probability (0.0-1.0). None means no filter.

GREEDYBEAR_CREATE_INDICATORS.description: Create STIX Indicators for every imported observable. Indicators are linked via based-on to the observable and via indicates to the MITRE Attack Pattern (if known).

GREEDYBEAR_DEEP_ENRICH.description: Per-IoC enrichment call adding the actual destination ports and the days-seen count to the Note, plus FireHOL blocklist categories as labels. One extra API call per IoC - slow for large feeds; needs an API key.
